cases.semantics: Jsoup Element.select evaluates the current Element before its descendants.
A compound context that has both classes remains selectable by its second Legado chain segment.
Legado class.xxx segments use Jsoup Element.getElementsByClass, whose collector includes the current context element.
The V2 parser's synthetic root represents a Jsoup Document boundary and must never be exposed as a selectable HTML element.

representativeSourceSet.classification: These frozen rules contain context-prefix chains. They are static consumers of the boundary, not claims that their live HTML currently places both selectors on the same node.

legadoSemantics.analyzer: AnalyzeByJSoup calls Element.select for CSS rules and ElementsSingle uses Element.getElementsByClass, Element.getElementsByTag and Collector.collect for class/tag/id segments.
legadoSemantics.collector: Jsoup Collector.collect starts traversal at the supplied root element.
legadoSemantics.documentBoundary: Document selection does not expose the synthetic V2 root as an ordinary HTML element.

failureCondition: V2 HTMLElement.querySelectorAll only traverses descendants. LegadoHtmlBridge used it for each chained context, so a selector that should match the current Element was silently omitted.
